items.exampleEn: Please don't trample the flowers when you walk across the garden.
items.exampleZh: 走過花園時請不要踩到花。

items.exampleEn: There was a slight tremor in her voice as she spoke about her old home.
items.exampleZh: 她談起老家時，聲音微微顫抖。

items.exampleEn: The ravages of time had turned the old wooden boat gray.
items.exampleZh: 歲月的摧殘讓那艘舊木船變得灰灰的。

items.exampleEn: Dry winter air often makes my skin itch.
items.exampleZh: 冬天乾燥的空氣常讓我的皮膚發癢。

items.exampleEn: Good parents instill honesty in their children.
items.exampleZh: 好父母會在孩子心中培養誠實的品格。

items.exampleEn: From the top of the hill, he bellowed his friend's name, but nobody answered.
items.exampleZh: 他在山頂大聲喊朋友的名字，但沒人回應。

items.exampleEn: The kids were soaked after their water fight in the yard.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在院子裡打完水仗後全身濕透。

items.exampleEn: A good teacher can animate even a boring topic.
items.exampleZh: 好老師連無聊的主題都能講得生動有趣。

items.sentenceEn: The cows trampled the grass near the gate.
items.sentenceZh: 牛群把大門附近的草踩平了。

items.audioEn: My dog keeps scratching his ears because they itch, so I'm giving him a bath tonight.
items.audioZh: 我的狗一直抓耳朵，因為耳朵癢，所以我今晚要幫牠洗澡。
items.questionZh: 說話者今晚打算做什麼？
options: Take the dog for a walk

items.sentenceEn: I felt a slight tremor while I was sitting at my desk.
items.sentenceZh: 我坐在書桌前時，感覺到一陣輕微的搖晃。

items.sentenceEn: Her shoes were soaked after the walk through the wet grass.
items.sentenceZh: 走過濕漉漉的草地後，她的鞋子都濕透了。

items.stemEn: Scientists recorded a small ____ under the mountain, but nobody felt it.
items.stemZh: 科學家在山底下測到一次小地震，但沒有人感覺到。

items.stemEn: A new puppy can ____ a quiet home and make everyone laugh.
items.stemZh: 一隻小狗就能讓安靜的家熱鬧起來，逗大家笑。

items.passageEn: On the first day of summer camp, we had to cross a shallow river, and we were soaked by the time we reached our cabins. That night, my arms began to itch from insect bites. The next morning, our leader bellowed, "Everyone up!" from outside the door. He said the camp was not just about fun; it was meant to instill teamwork and patience in us. By the end of the week, the wilderness felt like home.
items.passageZh: 夏令營第一天，我們得涉水過一條淺淺的河，走到小木屋時已經全身濕透。那天晚上，我的手臂被蟲咬得開始發癢。隔天早上，領隊在門外大吼：「全部起床！」他說夏令營不只是為了玩，而是要培養我們的團隊合作和耐心。到了週末，那片荒野已經讓我們覺得像家一樣。

questions.questionZh: 他們走到小木屋時怎麼樣了？
領隊認為夏令營的目的是什麼？
options: 教大家認識野外的動物

items.promptZh: 這張老照片看得出歲月的摧殘。
referenceEn: This old photo shows the ravages of time.
You can see the ravages of time in this old photo.
rubricZh: 要用 ravage 的複數形（例如 the ravages of time）
「看得出」可寫，例如 shows、you can see 等

items.instructionZh: 用 animate 造一個句子，描述什麼讓一個地方或活動變得熱鬧有生氣。
referenceEn: Music always animates our family parties.
The new coach animated the tired team.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 animate（例如 animates our parties、animated the team）
時態配合內容（例如 animates、animated 等）
